name: Tailscale
desc: A private network between your own devices, with nothing to set up.
desc_zh: 把你自己的设备连成一个私有网络，几乎不用配置。
solves: Reaching your own machine from outside usually means public IPs, port forwarding or a VPN server. Tailscale links the devices of one account, encrypted end to end.
solves_zh: 在外面连回自己的电脑，通常要公网 IP、端口转发或自建 VPN。Tailscale 把同一账号下的设备连起来，端到端加密。
best_for: You want to SSH, code on, or reach a service on your home or office computer from anywhere.
best_for_zh: 你想在外面 SSH 进家里或公司的电脑、在上面写代码，或访问它上面的服务。
notes: 首次公开发布取官方博客的正式发布公告《Tailscale has reached general availability》（2020-04-02）：https://tailscale.com/blog/tailscale-launch ，文内说明此前为受邀内测。GitHub 上最早的 release 对象是 2020-05-05 的 v0.98。源码解读基于提交 da6276d77025ee2bce288c4ccf07b35e14f253a7，BSD-3-Clause 许可。
